subject: Signal integration & staggered rollout — next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Kim <nora.kim@stratusretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Signal integration & staggered rollout — next steps

Hi Nora,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Per our conversation, I sketched a pragmatic, staggered rollout that lets StratusRetail start getting useful dashboards quickly while we incrementally add tracing hooks and alert routing with runbooks. The goal is to limit blast radius and make each phase verifiable.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Phase A (Week 1–2): Dashboard baseline + host/service metric mapping. Deliverables: dashboards, cost estimate, integration matrix.
- Phase B (Week 3–4): Lightweight tracing hooks for key request paths (checkout / recommendation). Deliverables: trace examples, sampling config.
- Phase C (Week 5–6): Alert taxonomy + routing + runbook draft; ops playbook for on-call.

Owners suggested: Laura (dashboards & integration matrix), Marcus (trace hook architecture + sampling), Ben (alerts + runbooks). We can adjust.

Attachments: integration-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — I attached a starter matrix with expected metrics, event names, and example dashboards.

Questions for you:
1) Are there any strict data residency or retention constraints we should bake into Phase A?
2) Which time zone preference for weekly check-ins (PT/ET)?

If that plan looks okay I’ll send a kickoff invite and a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

From: Nora Kim <nora.kim@stratusretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@stratusretail.com
Date: Tue, 7 Feb 2028 14:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Signal integration & staggered rollout — next steps

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — that phased approach sounds sensible. A couple of quick notes from our side:
- We need SOC 2 evidence and an outline of what telemetry leaves our VPC (high level) before Phase A starts.
- Data residency: we must ensure logs with PII are not exported outside us-west-2.
- Weekly check-ins: mornings PT work best for our ops team.

Procurement is cc’d for timeline visibility. Can you also share an estimated effort/engineering days for each phase so procurement can map to the SOW?

Best,
Nora
Nora Kim
Head of Site Reliability, StratusRetail
nora.kim@stratusretail.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Feb 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Signal integration & staggered rollout — next steps

Kim / team —

Thanks, Nora. I reviewed the integration matrix and expanded the Phase A checklist. Quick notes and proposed owners below (we should sync on Thursday to confirm):

Phase A (dashboards) — owners & tasks:
- Inventory & map metrics to services (Laura) — expected 3 engineer-days.
- Add exporter config + secure transport (Ben) — 2 engineer-days; we’ll ensure TLS and VPC egress rules.
- Validation tests (smoke dashboards + sample query) (Laura + Marcus) — 1 engineer-day.

Phase B (tracing) — initial tasks:
- Draft trace hook PR for checkout flow (Marcus) — attach: sample-trace-hook.patch
- Sampling guidance (Marcus + Kim) — set 1–5% initial, adjust by signal.

Phase C (alerts & runbooks):
- Error taxonomy draft (Ben) — map to Slack + email routing.
- Runbook template + on-call play (Ben + Laura).

On SOC 2 / data residency: Marcus, can you pull the high-level data flow diagram and a one-page SOC 2 excerpt (we can redact specifics) to share with Stratus? I’ll draft an effort table for procurement to drop into the SOW.

I’ll build a short Drive folder with artifacts and the runbook template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ObsOnboard

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Kim <nora.kim@stratusretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@stratusretail.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Signal integration & staggered rollout — next steps

Hi Nora / procurement team —

Great — thanks for the quick feedback. Per the team’s notes above, next concrete steps:
1) We’ll share a SOC 2 excerpt and a redacted data flow diagram by EOD Monday (Marcus).
2) Kickoff: Tue 14 Feb 2028, 10:00 PT — 45 minutes. Agenda: Phase A checklist, integration matrix review, security constraints, SOW effort table. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123kickoff
3) Drive folder with artifacts and the runbook template is live: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ObsOnboard
4) Attached: kickoff-agenda.pdf (includes proposed meeting agenda and Phase A milestones).

Estimated effort (draft for procurement):
- Phase A: 6 engineer-days total (dashboards + exporter + validation)
- Phase B: 5 engineer-days (trace hooks + sampling)
- Phase C: 4 engineer-days (alerts taxonomy + runbooks)

If that aligns, Laura will deliver the SOW table and Ben will start the error taxonomy draft.

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
